# Recommendation

We oppose the proposed rule. It assumes that retail investors read proxy statements, but the
Commission's own survey shows that fewer than 10 percent do, so the added disclosure will not reach
the investors it is meant to protect. The costs fall on issuers while the benefits never
materialize, and the rule therefore fails the cost-benefit analysis that Section 2(b) requires.

We ask the Commission to take three actions:

- withdraw proposed Rule 14a-21;
- reopen the comment period on the 2022 survey methodology;
- publish the survey's underlying response data.
